# ![Guild OS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Guild%20OS-Guild%20Manager-blueviolet?style=for-the-badge) 

### Premium Guild Management Addon for WoW TBC Anniversary, WoW: Forever and Retail

> Made with care by **Chehul** 🛡️

Guild OS replaces the default guild frame with a modern, feature-rich management hub that automatically collects and shares gear, professions, attunements, TMB wishlists, raid attendance, loot history and stats across your guild — no inspection required.

> **Clients:** WoW TBC Anniversary (Interface 20506), WoW: Forever (16001) and Retail, Midnight (120105) — one build
> serves all three. Retail has no Master Loot: the loot history records what each guildmate received from a boss, a
> guildmate offers an item they can still trade to the raid's loot council (`/gos offer`) and the trade to the winner is
> recorded as the award; DKP/EPGP and wishlists (Midnight's raid items from the Encounter Journal) work as on Forever.
> Retail also checks Midnight's consumables and shows each member's Mythic+ rating, keystone and Great Vault.
> guildos.me takes retail guilds too.

[![Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Discord-GuildOS%20support-5865F2?style=for-the-badge&logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/8XA6gmNjja)

> **Help, bugs and ideas:** join the [GuildOS support server on Discord](https://discord.gg/8XA6gmNjja).

---

## Features

### Guild Roster
- **Full guild roster** with sortable columns: Name, Level, Class, Race, Item Level, Professions, Attunements, Attendance%, Last Seen
- **Search** by name, class, zone or rank
- **Online/Offline toggle** with offline members shown in grayscale
- **Hover tooltips** with detailed character info
- **Click any member** to open their full inspection panel
- **Stats bar** showing total members, online count, and how many have Guild OS installed

### Member Detail Panel
- Full equipment inspection (17 gear slots) with quality-colored item names and tier-colored item levels
- Profession list with progress bars and rank display
- Character stats: HP, Mana, STR, AGI, STA, INT, SPI
- Raid attunement progress with per-quest tracking and visual progress bars
- **Account-wide attunements** — attunements completed on any linked alt are shown as complete with a `(conta: NomeDoChar)` indicator
- **Linked Characters** section (officer only) — link/unlink alts to share attunement data across a player's entire account group

### Attunement Tracker
Tracks quest-based attunement progress for all TBC raids:

| Raid | Tier |
|---|---|
| Karazhan | T4 |
| Gruul's Lair | T4 |
| Magtheridon's Lair | T4 |
| Serpentshrine Cavern | T5 |
| Tempest Keep: The Eye | T5 |
| Hyjal Summit | T6 |
| Black Temple | T6 |
| Sunwell Plateau | T6.5 |

Also tracks Heroic dungeon key reputation requirements (Honor Hold/Thrallmar, Cenarion Expedition, Lower City, Sha'tar, Keepers of Time).

**Account-wide propagation:** Officers can link a player's alts so that attunements completed on any character in the group are reflected across all of them — matching how Blizzard handles account-wide attunements on TBC Anniversary.

### TMB Integration (That's My BiS)
- Import TMB CSV exports with wishlist, prio, and received loot data
- Tooltip integration: hover any item to see who has it on their wishlist (Settings → Interface: always, only while holding Shift, or off)
- Syncs imported TMB data between officers via addon comms
- Dedicated TMB Loot tab for browsing all imported data

### Guild Recipe Browser
- Searchable browser for all recipes known across the guild
- **Icon-only profession filter tabs** — compact tab bar with one icon per crafting profession; full name shown on hover tooltip
- Gathering professions (Herbalism, Mining, Skinning, Fishing) are filtered out — only crafting professions shown
- Item tooltips list at most three crafters (online first, else the offline ones seen most recently) and count the rest

### Crafts (professions and craft orders in one tab)
- The catalog of recipes and who makes them, beside the queue of craft orders, both in view at once
- Click a recipe to open it in place: materials (what you carry against what the order needs), crafters, and the order
- `/gos order <item>`, Alt-click on an item, or **Order** in Find a Crafter: ask the guild's crafters for an item
- Open to every crafter who knows the recipe until one accepts, or sent to one crafter (a decline opens it to all)
- Per order: bring the materials or let the crafter use their own, plus an optional tip (on trust)
- Bars on the trade and mail windows put the materials, the item and the tip in with one click; a finished
  trade or a sent mail moves the order on
- The queue: For me · Mine · Open, one card per order with its four steps and the next thing to do; the tab and the minimap menu count what waits for you

### Raid Tracker
- Automatically detects when you enter a raid and tracks full sessions (start/end, boss encounters, player snapshots)
- Attendance scoring with penalty system: 100% base, −10% arrived late, −10% left early, −10% missing consumables
- View recent sessions and per-member attendance in the Raids tab

### Consumable Checker
- Scans all raid members for expected consumable buffs (TBC Anniversary and Retail; not on WoW: Forever)
- TBC: Flask, Food, Weapon Buff, Battle Elixir, Guardian Elixir
- Retail: Midnight's flask, food and augment rune, and your own weapon oil, read out of combat (on the ready check);
  what the game keeps hidden is unknown, never missing
- Reports which categories each player is missing
- Integrates with attendance scoring

### Mythic+ and the Great Vault (Retail)
- Each member's own client sends their Mythic+ rating, their keystone and their Great Vault for the week (raid,
  dungeons, delves and world)
- Shown on the member sheet and in an optional M+ roster column

### Guild Bank
- **Seen from anywhere**: whoever opens the bank with Guild OS shares it; every member sees every tab summed, grouped by
  category, searchable and sortable, with gold, free slots and who read it when
- **Tabs as the game draws them**, with an **Organized** view that shows the tab in order without moving anything
- **Organize for real** at the bank: merges stacks and sorts a tab (or every tab you may), one move at a time, with
  pause and stop; only where your rank withdraws without limit, or as guild master
- **Ledger** kept past the game's 25 lines, without double counting; the bank's gold over 30 days; top contributors
- **Needs**: officers set how many of each item the bank should hold; everyone sees what is short, a shopping list
- **Requests**: ask the officers for an item; they fill or decline it
- Item tooltips show how many the bank holds; `/gos bank [sort [all] | stop | sync | need]`

### Loot Tracker
- Automatically records every Rare+ item looted in raids and dungeons
- Stores item link, recipient, timestamp, raid name, and quantity
- Browse full loot history in the Loot tab
- Keeps up to 500 entries

### Officer Notes
- Write private notes and apply quick-tags (Role, Priority, Status) per guild member
- Notes are synced between officers in real time via addon comms

### Disciplinary Record (Officer Only)
- Every warning a member received, on their sheet: why, by whom, when, and whether it still counts
- A warning counts for the guild's term (1 to 365 days, 30 until an officer changes it) and each one moves the
  member up the guild's ladder; nothing is ever punished on its own
- Synced between officers only, revoked rather than deleted, and the warnings given on the guild's Discord show
  up too (`/gos record <name>`, `/gos record term <days>`)

### Trial Tracker (Officer Only)
- Track trial/recruit members; the trial length is the guild's (1 to 90 days, 30 until an officer changes it in
  Recruitment → Trials), and a new length applies to running trials too
- Optionally, every new member starts as a trial on its own (off by default; nobody already in the guild is affected)
- Records start date, sponsor, status (trial/ready to review/approved/denied), and evaluation notes
- Trials whose time is up show as "ready to review" and officers are told at login

### Officer Rank Configuration (Officer Only)
- Configure which guild ranks are considered "officers" in Settings → Guild rules
- Checkboxes for each guild rank — GM is always locked as officer
- Changes take effect immediately; only current officers can modify this setting
- Synced across all addon instances in the guild

### Guild-Wide Data Sync
- Automatically shares your gear, professions, attunements and stats with guildmates who have Guild OS installed
- Compressed and chunked communication protocol (LibSerialize + LibDeflate)
- Periodic sync every 5 minutes + manual sync button
- No manual inspection needed — data flows automatically

### Recruitment System (Officer Only)
- **Auto-recruit popup** — a notification appears on a configurable interval; click it to send your recruitment message to chat channels (LookingForGroup, Trade, etc.)
- **Send Now button** in the Recruitment tab for instant posting
- **Welcome message** — automatically posts a greeting in guild chat when a new member joins, with customizable message and Discord link
- **Guild invite** via `/guildos recruit invite <Player>`
- Full configuration UI in the Recruitment tab: message, interval, channels, welcome text, Discord link

### Groups (the guild's own group finder)
- **Activities as tiles**: this client's dungeons and raids, plus quests, world bosses, PvP and farming, each with its level range and how many groups and players it has right now
- **I am looking**: list yourself for one or several activities, with the roles you play (tank, healer, damage), a note and for how long
- **Form a group**: publish a group with its open spots by role; guildmates ask for a spot with one click, and only the leader hears it
- **The queue**: the leader invites or declines from the group's card; the spot closes when the player joins, and with no spot left the listing comes down by itself
- **The party forms itself**: with "Invite whoever asks" on, each request is an invite at once, and a guildmate without the addon whispers the leader `inv` (or `+`) to get one; a raid-sized group turns the party into a raid as soon as somebody joins. With it off, the leader answers from a small notice, tab closed
- **A discreet notice**: when a guildmate forms a group for your level, a small card at the top of the screen offers a spot in your role and goes away by itself (never in combat or while you are in a group; `/gos avail toast off` or Settings to turn it off)
- **Said again in guild chat**: a group listed with "Also post in guild chat" repeats its line every 10 minutes with how full it is, until it fills or comes down
- **The leader's panel**: your group as a card with its art, its seats, a bar of how full it is and the time it has left; from it you change the group, give it **+30 min**, **post it in chat now** (with the cooldown shown), run a **ready check** and take it down
- **Fits your group**: players looking for your activity (or anything) in a role you still need, each with one click to invite them in that role, and the spot closes when they arrive
- **A start time**: a group starts now or in 15, 30 or 60 minutes, shown on its card and in the guild line
- **Active at a glance**: how many groups are forming, how many are looking and how many are for you, with filters by dungeon, raid or other and "my level only"; groups for your level with a spot in your role come first, marked "for you"
- **Before it ends**: five minutes before your group or your listing expires, a notice offers +30 min or taking it down
- No server: it all travels on the guild's addon channel, expires on its own and reaches whoever logs in later. `/gos avail` opens it

### Tab System
| Tab | Access |
|---|---|
| Roster | All members |
| TMB Loot | All members |
| Raids | All members |
| Groups | All members |
| Loot | All members |
| Recruitment → Trials | Officers only |
| Recruitment | Officers only |

### Guild Frame Hook
Pressing **J** (or however you open the guild frame) opens Guild OS instead of the default Blizzard guild panel.

---

## Slash Commands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/guildos` or `/gos` | Toggle the roster window |
| `/guildos scan` | Re-collect your local character data |
| `/guildos sync` | Broadcast your data to the guild |
| `/guildos avail` | Open the Groups tab; `/guildos avail tank <text>` lists you, `/guildos avail off` delists you, `/guildos avail toast on\|off` the notice for new groups |
| `/guildos reset` | Wipe saved data and reload |

### Recruitment Commands (Officer+)

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/guildos recruit on/off` | Start/stop auto-recruit popup |
| `/guildos recruit status` | Show recruitment status |
| `/guildos recruit msg <text>` | Set recruitment message |
| `/guildos recruit interval <sec>` | Set popup interval (min 60s) |
| `/guildos recruit channel add/remove/list <name>` | Manage channels |
| `/guildos recruit welcome on/off` | Toggle welcome message |
| `/guildos recruit welcome msg <text>` | Set welcome message |
| `/guildos recruit discord <link>` | Set Discord link |
| `/guildos recruit invite <Player>` | Send guild invite |

---

## Installation

1. Download and extract into your `Interface/AddOns/` folder
2. The folder must be named `GuildOS`
3. Restart WoW or type `/reload`
4. Press **J** to open Guild OS or type `/guildos`

---

## Testing on the Forever beta

Guild OS ships **one build for both clients**: the release on CurseForge and Wago is marked for TBC
Anniversary and for WoW: Forever, so an addon manager pointed at the beta installs it like any other addon.
Builds between releases are posted as a GitHub pre-release and announced on the
[GuildOS Discord](https://discord.gg/8XA6gmNjja).

1. **Point the Guild OS companion at Anniversary first.** If you use the desktop companion, make sure it reads your
   `_anniversary_` folder before you install the beta, so it keeps syncing the right guild.
2. **Get the build** from CurseForge or Wago — an addon manager that supports WoW: Forever installs it for you —
   or the pre-release announced on Discord.
3. **Install** it into the beta client's own `Interface/AddOns` folder, not into `_anniversary_`.
4. **Load it.** If the beta's interface number is newer than the build lists, tick **Load out of date AddOns** on
   the AddOns screen at character select.
5. **Run the probe.** In game, type `/guildos probe`, then `/reload` so the result is written to disk. The probe
   records which client this is and which of the APIs, events and templates Guild OS uses exist.
6. **Send back** `WTF/Account/<account>/SavedVariables/GuildOS.lua` from the beta client's folder. It holds Guild
   OS's saved data for your guilds, including guild members' character names, officer notes and chat messages:
   share it only with the Guild OS maintainers.

## Libraries

- [LibStub](https://www.wowace.com/projects/libstub)
- [CallbackHandler-1.0](https://www.wowace.com/projects/callbackhandler)
- [LibSerialize](https://github.com/rossnichols/LibSerialize)
- [LibDeflate](https://github.com/SafeteeWoW/LibDeflate)
- [ChatThrottleLib](https://www.wowace.com/projects/chatthrottlelib)

---

## Notes

- **SendChatMessage to channels** (LookingForGroup, Trade, etc.) requires a hardware click due to Blizzard restrictions. Guild OS handles this by showing a clickable popup notification instead of sending automatically.
- Officer permission is determined by configurable guild rank threshold (default: rank ≤ 2). Adjustable in Settings → Guild rules by current officers.
- Data is stored per-guild in `GuildOSDB` SavedVariables (isolated per guild name+realm).
- Account-wide attunements require officers to manually link a player's alt characters via the Member Detail panel.

---

## Contributing

Bug reports and feature requests are welcome! Please use the [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/danielcosta42/GuildOS/issues) page, or talk to us on the [GuildOS Discord](https://discord.gg/8XA6gmNjja).

## Support

If Guild OS has been useful to your guild and you'd like to help keep it maintained, consider buying me a coffee ☕
